info.name: Blueprint API - REGRESSION
info.description: Everything: all endpoints, roles, validation, errors, versioning, idempotency, headers, timeouts. Creates and deletes its own test data. Use on test/staging, never on production.

exec: pm.test("token returned", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.data.tokenType === "Bearer" && !!j.data.accessToken, "token returned").to.be.true; });

pm.test("standard error envelope", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.error && j.error.code === "UNAUTHORIZED" && !!j.error.traceId && !!j.error.path, "standard error envelope").to.be.true; });
pm.test("generic message", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.message === "Invalid username or password", "generic message").to.be.true; });

item.name: Unknown user gives the same answer

exec: pm.test("generic message", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.message === "Invalid username or password", "generic message").to.be.true; });

pm.test("standard error envelope", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.error && j.error.code === "VALIDATION_FAILED" && !!j.error.traceId && !!j.error.path, "standard error envelope").to.be.true; });
pm.test("both fields reported", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.error.details.length >= 2, "both fields reported").to.be.true; });

pm.test("standard error envelope", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.error && j.error.code === "BAD_REQUEST" && !!j.error.traceId && !!j.error.path, "standard error envelope").to.be.true; });

pm.test("meta", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.meta.page === 0 && j.meta.size === 10 && j.data.length === 10 && j.meta.totalElements >= 30, "meta").to.be.true; });
pm.test("second page", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.meta.page === 1 && j.data.length === 5 && j.data[0].id === 6, "second page").to.be.true; });
pm.test("empty", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.data.length === 0, "empty").to.be.true; });
pm.test("all BOOKS", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.data.length > 0 && j.data.every(p => p.category === "BOOKS"), "all BOOKS").to.be.true; });
pm.test("sorted", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.data.every((p, i) => i === 0 || j.data[i - 1].price >= p.price), "sorted").to.be.true; });

pm.test("standard error envelope", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.error && j.error.code === "BAD_REQUEST" && !!j.error.traceId && !!j.error.path, "standard error envelope").to.be.true; });

pm.test("standard error envelope", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.error && j.error.code === "RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND" && !!j.error.traceId && !!j.error.path, "standard error envelope").to.be.true; });
pm.test("matches", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.data.length >= 11, "matches").to.be.true; });
pm.test("v1", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.meta.apiVersion === "1" && j.data.sku === undefined, "v1").to.be.true; });
pm.test("v2", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.meta.apiVersion === "2" && j.data.sku === "SKU-001", "v2").to.be.true; });
pm.test("v2 items", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.data.every(p => !!p.sku), "v2 items").to.be.true; });

pm.test("standard error envelope", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.error && j.error.code === "CONFLICT" && !!j.error.traceId && !!j.error.path, "standard error envelope").to.be.true; });

item.name: Validation: blank name and negative price

exec: pm.test("standard error envelope", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.error && j.error.code === "VALIDATION_FAILED" && !!j.error.traceId && !!j.error.path, "standard error envelope").to.be.true; });

pm.test("fields named", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.error.details.some(d => d.field === "name") && j.error.details.some(d => d.field === "price"), "fields named").to.be.true; });

pm.test("standard error envelope", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.error && j.error.code === "UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE" && !!j.error.traceId && !!j.error.path, "standard error envelope").to.be.true; });
pm.test("replaced", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.data.name === "Regression replace", "replaced").to.be.true; });
pm.test("same result", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.data.name === "Regression replace" && j.data.price === 55.5, "same result").to.be.true; });
pm.test("same id", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.data.id == pm.collectionVariables.get("idemProductId"), "same id").to.be.true; });
